outcome: Pregnancy complications (gestational diabetes mellitus, gestational hypertension)
Birth complications (birth type, cesarean section indication)
Perinatal complications (admission to neonatal intensive care unit, indication for ICU admission)
cohort: The study included 82 singleton pregnant women enrolled between 11+0 and 13+6 weeks of gestation.
finding: First trimester placental volume was positively correlated with maternal weight and gestational age at the time of measurement, but showed no significant relationship with gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, birth type, cesarean section indication, or neonatal ICU admission.
mod_finding: There was no significant relationship between mean placental volume and birth type or cesarean section indication.
